remarks: Rare find. Light, bright and charming 1931 New England colonial nestled in a coastal haven, right across from the Long Island Sound in sought after Harbor Shores with water views and public easement to beach across the street. Extensive 2024 renovation with top of the line designer appointments. Most picturesque grounds with mature professional landscaping, flowering trees/perennial gardens, fenced in backyard, detached 2 car garage, shed, and spacious screened porch with decorative ceiling fan. Drenched in natural light with newly refinished bleached hardwood floors, the expansive LR features an inviting fireplace flanked by built-in shelving, open to the adjoining office with full wall of custom book shelves. Enjoy entertaining inside or out in the sunny DR with French doors to the delightful screened porch overlooking the private backyard with stone patio and lush lawn. Keen attention to detail throughout with custom millwork, shiplap, moldings, full interior/exterior painting, plus totally remodeled state of the art kitchen, mudroom/laundry, full bath, and primary suite walk-in closet just completed. Rock solid, pristine home with generous storage in both the full walk up attic and large dry basement. Located outside the AE flood zone, in lowest zone X which does not require flood insurance. This highly sought after community is cherished by its residents because of the ease of access to the water, train station, and all that SONO has to offer, just 46 miles to Midtown.
